slides.title: Your AI can do **one job**. Which?
slides.sub: And what must it ask you before it does it?
slides.scene: Phoney the blue phone character sits behind a small interview desk at a tiny job fair, wearing reading glasses, reviewing a line of quirky job candidates: a stack of unpaid invoices with little legs, a bulging email inbox tray, a ticket roll, and a social media megaphone, all waiting nervously in a row. Funny, bright.

items.title: Sell tickets for your next event
Chase the invoices nobody likes chasing

slides.label: The catch
slides.caption: Every one of them has a moment where a **wrong guess costs you**.
slides.scene: Phoney the blue phone character carefully balances on a tightrope over a small pond holding a long pole, with an envelope, a ticket and a calendar page balanced on each end; crocodiles made of cartoon question marks peek out of the water below, grinning.

slides.text: Which job would you hand over first, and where would you make it ask?
